Exercise: Dips - Chest Version

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
push

Difficulty Level:
intermediate

Movement Patterns:

- push

Primary Muscles:

- chest

Secondary Muscles:

- shoulders
- triceps

Equipment:

- other

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
2.5

Energy Requirement:
high

Recovery Time:
48 hours

Goals:

- chest_development
- triceps_strengthening

Contraindications:

- condition: Shoulder instability, reason: May exacerbate shoulder issues.
- condition: Recent rotator cuff injury, reason: Risk of further damage.

Exercise Variations:

- name: Wide Grip Dips, primaryMuscles: ['chest', 'triceps']
- name: Close Grip Dips, primaryMuscles: ['triceps', 'shoulders']

Substitution Options:

- name: Push-ups, equipment: bodyweight
- name: Bench Dips, equipment: bench

Instructions:

- For this exercise you will need access to parallel bars. To get yourself into the starting position, hold your body at arms length (arms locked) above the bars.
- While breathing in, lower yourself slowly with your torso leaning forward around 30 degrees or so and your elbows flared out slightly until you feel a slight stretch in the chest.
- Once you feel the stretch, use your chest to bring your body back to the starting position as you breathe out. Tip: Remember to squeeze the chest at the top of the movement for a second.
- Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
